record_title: A sharper density profile for oscillating sumsets
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint is recent, so unindexed contemporaneous refinements remain a residual risk. An unpublished manuscript of I. Z. Ruzsa cited by Leonetti concerns the same density question; only Leonetti's description of its result was inspected, and no public identifier or full text was located. The result gives a strict refinement of the construction and an upper envelope for the extremal profile, not the true asymptotic order of Lambda(alpha). No independent validation is asserted.
